title: Left exact sheaf adjunction for cartesian affine étale functors
statement: Let S,T be schemes in universe u and f:T→S an affine morphism. Let F:S.FullAffineEtale→T.FullAffineEtale be continuous for their finite standard étale topologies [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Suppose there is a natural first projection p on underlying schemes such that for every A the square with p_A, the structure map of F(A), A→S, and f is cartesian. Then continuous sheaf pushforward along F on Type u sheaves has a left adjoint preserving finite limits. No directed system or coherence data is required.

proof.text: Pullback uniqueness and naturality of p identify F after affine inclusion with ordinary étale base change along f.
Use the restriction equivalences of 04HR. Under restriction the continuous pushforward agrees with ordinary étale direct image, since both evaluate at the same cartesian object and its arrows.

Conjugate the ordinary étale inverse-image adjunction by these equivalences. Its left adjoint preserves finite limits by 03Q1(2); equivalences preserve limits. Carry out the argument for Type u throughout.

proof_origin.place: 03Q1(2), and Topologies 04HR; source read online; adapted to full affine subcategories and Type u

lean.statement:
theorem affineEtale_cartesian_sheafAdjunction
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f]
    (F : S.FullAffineEtale ⥤ T.FullAffineEtale)
    (p : F ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion T ⋙ Etale.forget T ⋙ Over.forget T ⟶
      fullAffineEtaleInclusion S ⋙ Etale.forget S ⋙ Over.forget S)
    (hp : ∀ A : S.FullAffineEtale,
      IsPullback (p.app A) (F.obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom f)
    [F.IsContinuous (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) (fullAffineEtaleTopology T)] :
    ∃ L : Sheaf (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) (Type u) ⥤
        Sheaf (fullAffineEtaleTopology T) (Type u),
      Nonempty (L ⊣ F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) (fullAffineEtaleTopology T)) ∧
      PreservesFiniteLimits L
